title: MZ Official ARPG Plugin - Custom Keybound Attacks

posts.author: Catsumi
posts.body:
I am using the official ARPG Plug-in, and want to have it so that certain attacks are bound to buttons other than Z. For example, when the player hits A they shoot a fireball instead of the normal attack.
Thank you.
